import re

files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings/', entry_type='files')

for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    if '__' not in filename:
        continue
    date_part, rest = filename.split('__', 1)
    # Split rest on last '.' to get file_name and extension
    if '.' not in rest:
        continue
    file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    # Create destination directory: file_name
    dest_dir = f"~/documents/work/meetings/{file_name}"
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dest_dir, recursive=True)
    # Destination file path: file_name/date.ext
    dest_file = f"{dest_dir}/{date_part}.{ext}"
    # Move file
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(
        access_token=fs_token,
        source_file_path=file_path,
        destination_file_path=dest_file,
        overwrite=False
    )
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {dest_file}: {result}")
